extracted.intended_audience: journalists, students, editors, and writers in all professions
extracted.subtask_description: Style and usage guidance for newswriting following the Associated Press 2015 stylebook, including grammar, punctuation, news values, media law, and topic-specific style guides for beat reporting and broadcast. Intended as a comprehensive reference for producing and editing journalistic content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Grammar
rubrics_metrics.description: Associated Press rules on grammar for newswriting (part of the guide to newswriting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The stylebook details AP rules on grammar as an essential reference for journalists, students, editors, and writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Spelling
rubrics_metrics.description: Associated Press rules on spelling for newswriting (part of the guide to newswriting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes preferred spellings and variant handling consistent with AP style.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Associated Press rules on capitalization for newswriting (part of the guide to newswriting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies when to capitalize titles, proper nouns, and other elements in news copy.

rubrics_metrics.name: Abbreviation
rubrics_metrics.description: Associated Press rules on abbreviation for newswriting (part of the guide to newswriting).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on when and how to abbreviate organizations, titles, states, measurement units, and more.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guide to punctuation
rubrics_metrics.description: A dedicated section providing AP guidance on punctuation usage in news writing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers punctuation conventions (e.g., commas, semicolons, dashes) as applied to journalistic prose.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylebook key
rubrics_metrics.description: Legend/keys explaining symbols, abbreviations, or conventions used throughout the stylebook entries.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Helps users navigate entries and understand shorthand or notation in stylebook guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: What's new
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary of recent changes and updates to AP style in the 2015 edition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Highlights revisions and new entries so users can update practices to match current AP guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Stylebook (general entries)
rubrics_metrics.description: Core alphabetized AP style entries covering words, usage, and journalistic conventions (listed as 'Stylebook').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The central reference section with specific entries on terminology, usage, and editorial decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of news values
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on news values — the criteria that determine what is newsworthy.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides principles for editors and reporters about selecting and prioritizing stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Briefing on media law
rubrics_metrics.description: Overview of legal considerations for journalists and media organizations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers press law topics relevant to reporting and publishing (libel, privacy, access, etc.) to inform legally safe practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Kills, correctives and clarifications
rubrics_metrics.description: Procedures and guidance for killing copy, issuing correctives, and publishing clarifications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explains how to handle errors, retractions, and newsroom decisions to withhold or remove content.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sending text stories
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on formatting and transmitting text stories to wire services and newsrooms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes conventions and technical/format expectations for submitting stories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Social media guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules and best practices for journalists' and newsrooms' use of social media.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers conduct, sourcing, verification, attribution, and platform-specific considerations for posting and engaging.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sports guidelines and style
rubrics_metrics.description: AP style rules and conventions specific to sports reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes terminology, score formatting, athlete/team references, and beat-specific practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Food guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Style guidance for reporting on food topics.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses terminology, measurement, recipe references, and specialty vocabulary for food journalism.

rubrics_metrics.name: Fashion guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Style rules for writing about fashion.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers naming designers, clothing terminology, and other beat-specific conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Religion guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance for reporting on religion and faith communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes respectful usage, proper names, titles, and issues around belief reporting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Business guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: AP style guidance tailored to business and financial reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Covers financial terms, company naming, market data presentation, and beat-specific formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Broadcast guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Style and formatting guidance for broadcast journalism.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Addresses scripting, timing, readability for spoken copy, and other broadcast-specific practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Photo captions
rubrics_metrics.description: Standards for writing photo captions and credit lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifies what information to include, attribution formats, and caption style conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Editing marks
rubrics_metrics.description: Conventional editorial marks and notation used in copy editing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides the symbols and their meanings for manual editing and correction workflows.
